veranderings.voor: Die Hoëveld lê op hierdie plato in provinsies
veranderings.na: Die Hoëveld lê op hierdie plato, in provinsies
veranderings.rede: A comma separates the two place phrases so 'plato in provinsies' is not read as one unit; the protected phrase 'in provinsies soos Gauteng' stays intact.
